text:
alex: Kicking off model enablement for nova-13b-quantv3 in eu-west. Change window starts in ~30m. Pinlist for this cutover: nova-13b:quantv3 -> primary, nova-13b:quantv2 -> fallback, nova-13b:quant-int8 -> cold fallback. Ops please ack; telemetry watchers needed.

maria: Ack. Setting up telemetry watchers + alert rules. Who owns rollout notes and rollback criteria?

alex: I own notes. Rollback triggers: p95 token latency > 300ms sustained for 5m OR 5xx/error rate > 1.5% over 5m OR a >3pt regression on hallucination eval. Canary at 5% for 10m first.

sylvia: Noted. Deploybot, can you schedule the canary now?

deploybot: Schedule accepted. Canary details: model=nova-13b-quantv3 region=eu-west traffic=5% duration=10m start=2601122394. Canary run id=canary-2621.

observability-bot: Dashboard created: /dash/model-rollouts/nova-13b-quantv3. Alerts configured: p95_token_time>300ms (5m), 5xx_rate>1.5% (5m), eval_regression_hallucination>3pts. Links: https://obs.internal/dash/model-rollouts/nova-13b-quantv3

maria: Added fallback ordering to the catalog entry: [quantv3, quantv2, quant-int8]. Quick question — does quant-int8 preserve prefix/KV cache compatibility?

alex: Yes, quant-int8 supports our KV cache policy for resumes (dequant/rehydrate on restore). It's slightly slower on long prefixes but fine as cold fallback.

sylvia: Drafting release notes for product — short snippet below, will paste to #product after cutover: 

```
- Enabled nova-13b-quantv3 (eu-west) with fallback to quantv2 and quant-int8.
- Expected median token latency improvement ~12% in our lab runs.
- Rollback criteria: p95_token_time>300ms, 5xx_rate>1.5%, or eval regression >3pts.
- Telemetry: https://obs.internal/dash/model-rollouts/nova-13b-quantv3
```

alex: Plan after canary: if healthy at 10m -> move to 30% for 15m -> then gradual ramp to 100% over next 2 hours. If any alert fires, deploybot will drain the canary and pin traffic back to quantv2 automatically. Manual rollback command for ops: `/deploybot rollback catalog nova-13b reason="telemetry" pin=quantv2`

deploybot: If an alert is triggered I will initiate drain and pin rollback unless a manual abort is received within 60s. I will also post a short thread in #incidents with the run id and telemetry snapshot.

sylvia: I'll run smoke evals at +1m and +5m and post results here. maria will monitor telemetry and own alert triage.

maria: Owning telemetry. I'll escalate to ops if thresholds hit and will post a short status at +15m and +1h in #product.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post the final rollout note after the 30% step. :thumbsup:
